title: Artin--Schreier linear obstruction in a restricted series disc
statement:
Let $E$ be a field [def-weil-field] with a nonarchimedean real absolute value and positive residue characteristic $p$, where the residue field is $E^\circ/\{x:|x|<1\}$ and $E^\circ=\{x:|x|\le1\}$ [def-trf-valuation-ring]. For a real $r>0$ let $D_r(E)$ be the ring of formal series $\sum_{i\ge0}c_iW^i$ with $c_i\in E$ and $|c_i|r^i\to0$, with coefficientwise addition and Cauchy multiplication; write $\|\sum c_iW^i\|_r=\sup_i |c_i|r^i$. Let $m\ge1$ and $P=\sum_{i=0}^m A_iW^i\in E[W]\subset D_r(E)$, allowing $A_m=0$. Assume $\|pP\|_r<1$. Let $N$ be the unique integer with $p^N\le m<p^{N+1}$ and choose $\theta_0,\ldots,\theta_N\in E$ with $\theta_n^{p^n}=A_{p^n}$ (so $\theta_0=A_1$). Suppose
$$\inf\{\|P+C^p-C+H\|_r:C,H\in D_r(E),\ \|pC^p\|_r<1,\ \|H\|_r<1\}\le1.$$
Then $r\left|\sum_{n=0}^N\theta_n\right|\le1$. This holds for every choice of the indicated roots; no algebraic closedness or completeness of $E$ is assumed beyond the roots explicitly supplied.
